async def act(page):
    # Get the link for the bottom post's title
    title_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='You need to know what the tilde (~) does in Excel', exact=True)
    # Get the previous link with text 'technology' (the category link)
    # We can use page.locator with XPath to find the previous sibling link with text 'technology'
    # But to avoid XPath, use Playwright's built-in methods: get all 'technology' links and filter by position
    # Since the category link is directly before the title link in the document order,
    # we can get the index of the title link among all links, then get the 'technology' link at that index-1
    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    title_index = None
    for i in range(await all_links.count()):
        link_text = await all_links.nth(i).text_content()
        if link_text == 'You need to know what the tilde (~) does in Excel':
            title_index = i
            break
    if title_index is None:
        return 'Title link not found.'
    # Get the category link at index title_index-1
    category_link = all_links.nth(title_index - 1)
    category_text = await category_link.text_content()
    # Get the second article for the date
    articles = page.get_by_role('article')
    if await articles.count() < 2:
        return 'Not enough articles found.'
    bottom_article = articles.nth(1)
    # Find the date link within the article (link with 'December' in text)
    date_link = bottom_article.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='December')
    date_text = await date_link.text_content()
    # Combine results
    result = f'{category_text}, {date_text}'
    return result
